description: The latest snow report for one resort with provenance: new snow 24 h / 48 h, base depth, snow water equivalent, percent of normal, 7-day trend, rating, season status, plus a cam summary and the canonical PeakCam URL to cite. Sources: `snotel` = measured at a USDA NRCS SNOTEL station near the resort (station elevation, not the summit), `open_meteo` = weather-model estimate for resorts without a station.

slug.description: PeakCam resort slug, lowercase kebab-case, e.g. `breckenridge` or `ski-portillo`. Get it from search_resorts.

name: get_resort_conditions

capturedAt.description: When `stillUrl` was captured by PeakCam. Null for operator-published stills, whose age PeakCam does not know.

credit.description: Attribution line to show with the frame. Null means credit the resort.

elevation.description: Operator-stated elevation label as published, e.g. `11,000 ft`.

kind.description: What the cam looks at. Null when not classified.

live.description: True when the last health check succeeded, false when the feed is failing or auto-disabled, null when PeakCam has never checked it. Health, not proof of a live broadcast.

pageUrl.description: The PeakCam page that plays this cam.

sourceTermsUrl.description: The operator's terms governing reuse of this feed, when known.

sourceUrl.description: The operator's stream or page. Attribution and rights belong to the operator.

stillUrl.description: A still image for the cam: the operator's own snapshot when it publishes one, else PeakCam's last captured frame. Null for players with no still.

timelapses.description: Rendered clips, once PeakCam renders them for this cam.

renderedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant the clip was rendered.

stormDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the storm a `storm` clip covers.

window.description: Which clip: `24h` (rolling day), `storm` (one storm, see `stormDate`), or another label.

canonicalUrl.description: The resort's PeakCam page. Cite this.

forecast.description: Latest run per model and point, once stored forecasts are live.

snowfallLo.description: Low end of the spread across models / members; null for a single model.

model.description: Model id as the provider names it, or `blend` for PeakCam's skill-weighted blend.

forecastScores.description: Per-model verification at this resort, once computed.

biasRatio.description: Sum(forecast) / sum(observed); above 1 means the model over-forecasts snow.

day1Mae.description: Mean absolute error of the day-1 snowfall forecast, cm.

license.description: URL of the terms that govern reuse.

state.description: US state / CA province code, or the country name for Andes resorts.

measuredNow.description: Latest observation per station, once the station layer is live.

newSnowIn.description: New snow since the previous observation, inches.

aliases.description: Other names the resort is known by, e.g. `A-Basin`.

descriptionSource.description: `operator`: the resort's own copy. `generated`: a model-written draft, labelled as such on the page. `editor`: hand-written by PeakCam.

passes.description: Multi-resort passes the resort is on.

trailMapUrl.description: The operator's trail map (linked, never copied).

score.description: Today's 0–100 score, once the scorer is live.

asOf.description: The YYYY-MM-DD day (US Pacific) the status was evaluated for.

openDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD opening date for the current season, confirmed or projected.

openDateKind.description: Whether `openDate` was announced by the resort or is a third-party projection.

seasonLabel.description: The season the dates belong to, e.g. `2026-27`.

sourceUrl.description: Where the date was sourced from, when recorded.

status.description: `open` once a resort-confirmed opening date has passed (or a Southern-hemisphere season is still inside its closing date); `closed` before a confirmed opening date or after a closing date; `unknown` when PeakCam has only a projection or no date.

baseDepth.description: Snow depth at the station or model point, inches.

measuredAt.description: ISO-8601 instant the report carrying this value was written.

elevationFt.description: Station elevation in feet. Measurements describe this elevation, not the resort's summit.

value.description: Null when not reported or suppressed as unreliable.

narrative.description: One-paragraph plain-language conditions summary, when the report carries one.

newSnow24h.description: New snow in the last 24 hours, inches.

measuredAt.description: ISO-8601 instant the report carrying this value was written.

elevationFt.description: Station elevation in feet. Measurements describe this elevation, not the resort's summit.

value.description: Null when not reported or suppressed as unreliable.

newSnow48h.description: New snow in the last 48 hours, inches.

measuredAt.description: ISO-8601 instant the report carrying this value was written.

elevationFt.description: Station elevation in feet. Measurements describe this elevation, not the resort's summit.

value.description: Null when not reported or suppressed as unreliable.

outlook.description: Derived short-term outlook from the conditions engine.

pctOfNormal.description: SWE as a percentage of the station's 1991–2020 median for this day of the water year. Null when there is no station, when SWE is under 2 in, or outside the 10–300 % band where the ratio is meaningful.

measuredAt.description: ISO-8601 instant the report carrying this value was written.

elevationFt.description: Station elevation in feet. Measurements describe this elevation, not the resort's summit.

value.description: Null when not reported or suppressed as unreliable.

reportedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant of the latest report.

source.description: Source of the latest report as a whole (the per-field `source` values agree with it today).

measuredAt.description: ISO-8601 instant the report carrying this value was written.

elevationFt.description: Station elevation in feet. Measurements describe this elevation, not the resort's summit.

value.description: Null when not reported or suppressed as unreliable.

tags.description: Condition tags from the conditions engine, e.g. `powder`.

elevationFt.description: Station elevation in feet. Measurements describe this elevation, not the resort's summit.

value.description: Direction of snow-water-equivalent change over the last 7 days.

snow.description: Null when the resort has never had a snow report.

stations.description: Observation stations serving the resort, once the station layer is live.

distanceKm.description: Great-circle distance from the resort's coordinates.

rank.description: 1 = the preferred station for its role.

role.description: Where the station sits relative to the resort.

sourceId.description: The provider's own identifier (SNOTEL triplet, ICAO code, GHCN id).

updatedAt.description: Newest instant among the snow report and cam checks/captures.

title: Resort conditions
